title: Inventory Value for a day after release counts a bin below zero
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in.
  • Every part in this case is tracked and costs $10.00 per unit.
  • Day {Date-A} (for example 14 October 2026) is on or after the day the Part Lifecycle build reached this environment.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-IVNET-DAY-01) has been active and tracked at {Location-A} since {Date-A}, with -2 in its only bin {Bin-A} at the end of {Date-A}.
  • Line {Line-1} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL IV NET NEXT DAY") of work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) took 2 of {Part-A} from {Bin-A} while {Bin-A} held 0, which put {Bin-A} at -2.
  • The steps run on a day after {Date-A}, so the report's saved figures for {Date-A} exist.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports → Inventory Value.
  2. Set the Location filter to {Location-A} only.
  3. Set the as-of date to {Date-A}.
  4. Type the part number of {Part-A} in the report's Search box.
  5. Read the {Part-A} row and the Totals row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: {Part-A} is listed for {Date-A} with Qty -2.00, Unit Cost $10.00 and Total Cost -$20.00 (-2 × $10.00), and Totals reads Qty -2.00 and Total Cost -$20.00: the figures saved for a date from release on count the bin below zero.
  • Step 5: The row is not left out and does not read 0.00 or $0.00.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; bug SV-10380 (Inventory Value report ignores negative bins and overstates net inventory value; Ready to Fix, updated 9 Oct 2026; ships with this epic per Chris Ward's comments of 24 Sep and 7 Oct 2026), description, reproduction table and acceptance criteria, read 13 Oct 2026; PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), §2 Accounting (new bullet on saved figures and the count of bins below zero), read 13 Oct 2026; QA lead's set-up answers of 9 Oct 2026 (situation 1: a bin below zero). Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • SV-10380 acceptance criteria: “Inventory Value figures saved for dates before release keep their saved values. Only dates from release on count bins below zero.”
  • SV-10380 acceptance criteria: “Report rows, aggregate totals, exports and newly captured snapshots use the same net quantity basis for the same scope and cutoff. Quantity-dependent displayed values use that same basis.”
  • PRD §2 Accounting: “Inventory Value figures already saved for past dates keep their saved values. The count of bins below zero, which ships with this release, applies from release on and does not rework earlier dates.”
